Production Orders

The Production Order Costs screen provides a detailed cost analysis for items manufactured through production orders.

This report helps you understand the total cost of producing finished goods by breaking down all input costs from your manufacturing process.

Cost Analysis Features

For each production order, the system displays the cost of raw materials, components, and other inputs used in manufacturing.

The cost per unit is automatically calculated by dividing the total input costs by the quantity of finished goods produced.

All costs are presented in a clear, itemized format that shows exactly what went into producing your finished products.

Using This Report

Use this cost information to analyze production efficiency and ensure your manufacturing processes are profitable.

The detailed breakdown helps you set appropriate selling prices based on actual production costs.

Review costs regularly to identify opportunities for cost reduction and improve your production margins.
